status: references with a refutation record: REFUTATION.md in this directory

number_format.flush: a value below 1e-50 of the largest magnitude of its unit in the analysis is printed as 0 (zero by symmetry or decoupling)

conventions: README.md in this directory, section "Conventions a product must match or map"

cases.serves: AC-002 on a benchmark-shaped model: CQC on a close pair (about 5 percent) with same- and opposite-sign contributions, every modal rule
cases.purpose: 15 m pipe along the space diagonal toward (1,1,1), 8 equal members, anchored at A, a linear spring of 8 N/m along global X at the tip B, which splits the first bending pair

modal_basis.basis: DEL-04-09 REQ-005: eigenproblem on the free DOFs with dynamic-only restraints included; excitation p_k = (M R_k)_f; every finite mode listed, shapes for the modes any request extracts

frequency_list.scope_cluster_tolerance: delta_c = 2^-20 on eigenvalues, lambda_{i+1} - lambda_i <= delta_c lambda_{i+1} (DEL-04-09 REQ-003)

cqc_correlation.note: rho_ij of the units of the combination (a repeated cluster is one unit), for the extracted modes; the periodic set uses its leading block

element_end_forces_member_axes.frame: member axes: x from node i to node j, y = y_reference made normal to x and unit, z = x cross y; the rows of each member's frame in global axes are in `frames` (and in derived_model.member_frames)
element_end_forces_member_axes.keys: <member>.<i|j>.<Fx|Fy|Fz|Mx|My|Mz>_m: the end forces and moments acting on the element at that end, components along the member's x, y, z
element_end_forces_member_axes.note: these are the signed contributions of the global-axis blocks rotated into member axes, and magnitudes combined from those rotated contributions; they differ from the global-axis values because a combined magnitude is a property of the axes it is combined in, and these frames are not signed permutations of the global axes

cases.serves: AC-002: the grouping and ten percent methods on a set of modes where the two differ (a three-mode chain; CLM-001, REQ-003)
cases.purpose: the pipe of C9 with a stiff tip spring of 1048576 N/m along global X instead of 8 N/m: modes 21, 22 and 23 form a chain (f22 within 10 percent of f21, f23 within 10 percent of f22, not of f21)
